matched.product: Shredded Mozzarella Cheese (bulk bag 'Mozzarella Cheese with Starch', frozen)
matched.note: Catalog item is sold loose by weight; which Leprino bulk pack the deli repacks is unknown. Data is from a UAE food-service listing of the Leprino 2 kg frozen shredded bag; ingredients, allergen line, storage and producer were read from the pack-label photo on that page. Treat as unsure until the actual bulk pack label is checked. No nutrition on the page.

ingredients.text: Mozzarella Cheese (Pasteurised Milk, Salt, Lactic Cultures), Potato Starch. Processing Aids: Vegetarian Rennet, Calcium Chloride (E509).

storage.text: Keep Frozen at -18°C or colder. Once thawed, DO NOT refreeze, but keep refrigerated below 4°C, and use within 7 days
